question: Effect of omitting the initial source excerpt on all-29-requirement compliance and all-Run provider input plus output tokens, with identical source, derived data and retrieval capabilities.
randomization: Independent random.Random(seed).getrandbits(1) per adjacent pair; 0 compact-first, 1 expanded-first. Saved once; no rebalancing.

quality.run_pass: Every public requirement pass with complete adopted evaluation; a known failure remains failure even with other unobserved requirements.
quality.interval: Bonferroni simultaneous 97.5% exact Clopper-Pearson intervals for the two discordant probabilities; difference gives at least 95% coverage.
quality.missingness: A verified requirement failure fixes the binary outcome at 0 even if other checks are incomplete. Unknown binary outcomes retain all-assigned worst/best bounds and interval envelopes; no complete-case replacement or superiority flag. Identity-invalid results are retained as recorded facts but treated as unknown for inference.

analysis.token_interval: Student t interval of within-pair compact-minus-expanded arithmetic total-token differences
analysis.mean_ratio: ratio of arithmetic Run means; secondary paired percentile bootstrap interval
analysis.missing_tokens: No all-assigned mean or primary interval when any true Run total is unknown. Known partial sums and complete-pair summaries are secondary only. Quality inspection incompleteness does not veto valid complete token inference.
analysis.multiplicity: Separate marginal 95% intervals, not a joint confidence region or an either-endpoint-success test. Optional conjunction of directional supports is an intersection-union claim; no independence assumption or product of powers.
analysis.all_equal_tokens: Keep point estimate; no zero-width population interval or support. Quality inference remains independent.
analysis.conclusion_rule: Report token reduction, quality difference and additional joint conclusions separately. Research informativeness is not defined by quality superiority.
analysis.integrity: Model/task/input provenance faults block both; evaluator/artifact/spec identity faults block quality; usage faults block tokens. Coverage, behavior audit and cleanup are separate operational records; unknown audit faults remain shared.

planning.target_rationale: A prespecified planning judgment: one fifth of a rounded 3M Run scale; not pilot effect, price saving, or established user utility threshold.
planning.quality_precision_rationale: Estimation resolution at pC=pE=0.8, binary correlation 0; NOT an acceptable quality-loss margin.
planning.resource_feasibility: 24-hour PC allocation, full existing Go allowance, no paid overage, zero discretionary disk reserve; completed Runs use verified lossless NTFS compression outside measurement timing; bounded one-pair sharing with physical checks.
planning.selection_rule: 320 fixed pairs selected before new outcomes under the accepted allocation/resource comparison. Do not change N in response to outcomes or runtime consumption.
planning.token_target_role: Historical planning scenario and additional minimum-effect flag, not a mandatory research success criterion.
planning.quality_precision_role: Historical precision scenario, not a quality-loss boundary or adopted minimum N.

stopping.resume: Only never-dispatched slots in original order after documented repair and fresh equality of all pins, saved evidence integrity and owned cleanup. In-flight or uncertain slots are never replayed.
stopping.evaluation_recovery: Same frozen artifact only, preserve every attempt, at most two recovery rescores after future authorization. A confirmed failure makes all-29 binary quality known; unfinished requirement inspection remains separate. Unresolved environment faults still stop further dispatch until safe recovery, but do not invalidate already measured independent metrics.
stopping.usage_format_change: Retain all Runs and calls. Missing usage blocks the token primary interval, not otherwise valid quality inference. Unknown dispatch is never replayed.

launch.notes: Frozen plan is immutable. A separate explicit user approval bound to its SHA-256 is required by the launcher. Fresh pre-dispatch evidence is appended at execution.
launch.plan_hash_algorithm: SHA256 of exact saved plan file bytes. All analysis entry points supply that file; the parsed value must equal the passed plan and both observations and launch receipt must carry its hash.

resource_evidence.credential_source: Windows user environment OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY; value never recorded
resource_evidence.capacity_confirmed: per-pair physical check; API exhaustion pauses; whole-study completion not guaranteed

preparation.authority: User instructed completion of execution, storage/sharing and 320-pair freeze preparation.

storage.definition: Pilot-based reservation only. All raw originals retained. At most one pair is staged/downloaded/restored at once. Four-Run retained cohort divided by two estimates a pair, including historical archive duplication; two copies of the largest Run directory provision scratch. Native-state snapshot growth and future tails remain unbounded.
storage.docker_storage_observed: Docker WSL data and main VHDX files are on C:; no container was started.

execution.original_retention: Retain all original Run files; only verified temporary public/transfer copies may be deleted.
execution.api_policy: User confirmed paid overage disabled. Pause on unavailable API; no dollar reservation, account rotation, model switch or Run replacement.
execution.release_policy: One reviewed pair per prerelease in fukuda-yuki/sample2; <=1 GiB parts, <=1000 assets per release.
execution.reproduction_limits: Native state/auth caches, evaluation DB/WALs and runtime binaries remain local. Public exclusions and notices are mandatory; no self-contained environment replay claimed.
